map.根据您的旅行需求，对比不同类型旅行保险的保障范围与价格: Compare the coverage and price of different types of travel insurance against your travel needs
map.📋 旅行保险主要保障项目: 📋 Main Coverage Items of Travel Insurance
map.因意外事故导致身故或伤残的一次性赔付: A lump-sum payout for death or disability caused by an accident
map.旅行期间因疾病或意外产生的医疗费用（含门诊和住院）: Medical costs from illness or accident during the trip (including outpatient and inpatient care)
map.需要紧急转送回国或到更好医院的费用: The cost of urgent evacuation back home or to a better hospital
map.航班延误超过约定时间（通常4-6小时）的赔付: Compensation when a flight is delayed beyond the agreed time (usually 4 to 6 hours)
map.托运行李丢失或延误超过约定时间的赔付: Compensation when checked baggage is lost or delayed beyond the agreed time
map.因不可抗力导致行程取消或缩短的费用补偿: Compensation for costs when a trip is cancelled or shortened due to force majeure
map.因意外造成第三方人身伤害或财产损失的赔偿: Compensation for third-party injury or property damage caused by an accident
map.旅行期间银行卡被盗刷的损失补偿: Compensation for losses from bank card fraud during the trip
map.欧美发达国家建议至少50万，申根签证要求不低于3万欧元（约25万人民币）: For developed countries in Europe and North America, at least CNY 500000 is advised; the Schengen visa requires no less than EUR 30000 (about CNY 250000)
map.高风险运动（潜水、滑雪、登山等）通常需要额外加保: High-risk sports (diving, skiing, mountaineering and so on) usually need extra cover
map.选择有全球救援网络的保险公司，关键时刻能救命: Choose an insurer with a global rescue network, which can save your life when it matters
map.建议出发前1-2周购买，行程取消险需要提前更久: Buying 1 to 2 weeks before departure is advised; trip cancellation insurance needs an even earlier start
map.如有既往症需如实告知，否则可能拒赔: Pre-existing conditions must be disclosed, otherwise the claim may be refused
map.就医、购物等保留好发票和证明材料，方便理赔: Keep invoices and supporting documents for medical treatment and shopping to make claims easier
map.注意登革热等热带疾病保障: Watch for coverage of tropical diseases such as dengue
map.日韩/港澳台: Japan, Korea / Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan
map.医疗费用较高，建议足额投保: Medical costs are high, so buy full coverage
map.必须满足申根签证要求: Must satisfy the Schengen visa requirement
map.医疗费用极高，建议高额投保: Medical costs are extremely high, so high coverage is advised
map.注意疾病保障和紧急救援: Pay attention to disease coverage and emergency rescue
map.⚠️ 以上价格和保障内容仅供参考，实际保障范围、免责条款和价格请以保险公司官方条: ⚠️ The prices and coverage above are for reference only. Actual coverage, exclusions and prices follow the insurer's official terms. Please read the insurance contract carefully before buying.
map.factor=max(0.5,7÷7)=1，基础方案 basePrice[200: factor = max(0.5, 7 ÷ 7) = 1, so the base plan basePrice[200, 400] × 1 × ageMult × sportMult = CNY 200 to 400. Schengen requires medical coverage of at least EUR 30000 (about CNY 250000), so pick a compliant plan.
map.选滑雪 sportMult 上浮、delay 档 high 时延误赔付×1.5，: Choosing skiing raises sportMult, and with the high delay tier the delay payout is × 1.5; use the comparison tab to find the smallest minTotal.
map.basePrice×天数系数×年龄系数×运动系数；长线天数÷7 越大越贵。: basePrice × duration factor × age factor × sport factor. The longer the trip (days ÷ 7), the more expensive it gets.
map.欧洲方案医疗保额须≥3 万欧元，否则签证可能拒。: European plans need medical coverage of at least EUR 30000, otherwise the visa may be refused.
map.旅行保险对比助手。旅行出行工具，出行必备，支持离线使用。: Travel Insurance Comparison Assistant. A travel tool that is essential for trips and works offline.
